machine.profile: release, no-default-features, system allocator with counting wrapper

method.prepared: Identical BINARY(width) values and nullable schemas. Stock starts on prebuilt GenericRowData or BinaryRowData and executes released generated code in Java. Previous and candidate production Calc start on prepared Arrow Binary or FixedSizeBinary. Rust timers surround production Calc execution and output consumption; previous retains the real scalar JVM callback and argument/result marshalling. Setup, initial JNI input import, output export and perimeter transposes are excluded. Full schema and Arrow output equality checked before timing; length/first/last-byte checksum checked in every trial.
method.order: Rotate stock/previous/native each trial, configurations and engines run serially; no concurrent builds or tests.
method.nullable_values: Every seventh input NULL when enabled; all schemas nullable.
method.pipeline: Flink 2.2.1 BINARY(16), bounded 1M-row source, parallelism one, rowwise blackhole sink. Both transposes retained. Candidate requires jvm=[] plus positive consumed NativeCalc work; previous uses the canonical baseline encoder first on the classpath and requires its JVM evaluator. Separate sequential JVMs, two warmups and five measured jobs.

optimization_profile.observation: The general-purpose scalar codec dominates wide inputs. The optimized implementation uses released base64-simd 0.8.0, standard padded alphabet, runtime ISA dispatch and portable fallback. Final construction relies on checked offsets and guaranteed ASCII output, omitting the redundant UTF-8 scan. Full Arrow validation remains in regression tests.

second_profile.observation: After SIMD encoding, redundant core UTF-8 validation still costs about 17% of sampled main-thread work.
